title: Low-volatility effect — expanded certified panel retest

universe.note: TATASTEEL/BAJAJFINSV and other BLOCKED_CA names outside scope remain outside

hypothesis_plain: Do calmer stocks give investors better returns for the amount of risk taken?
hypothesis: Lowest trailing 20d realized-volatility quintile outperforms the highest-vol quintile on a 21d hold after CNC costs, with positive net mean return and harness PROMOTE on discovery; confirmation requires the same gates on the untouched confirmation partition.
null_hypothesis: No positive cost-aware OOS low-minus-high vol edge after CNC costs; any gross gap is economically destroyed by costs, statistically underpowered, or fails confirmation.
volatility_definition: cross-sectional realized volatility = std of daily simple returns over lookback window
ranking: inverse vol percentile rank; long top quintile (lowest vol), short bottom quintile (highest vol)
benchmark: equal-weight universe available on rebalance date (long-only Sharpe proxy comparison); primary portfolio is low-minus-high
turnover_treatment: conservative full one-way turnover charged each rebalance via round_trip_cost_pct
primary_metric: mean_net of low-minus-high portfolio per rebalance (fraction)

statistical_significance.multiple_testing: single primary specification; DSR n_trials=1 (no family-wise mining)

economic_significance.note: Statistically significant but mean_net<=0 is FAIL. Gross-only edge destroyed by costs is FAIL. Trivial positive net without harness PROMOTE is not PASS.

discovery_pass_criterion: harness verdict PROMOTE AND mean_net > 0 on discovery partition
confirmation_criterion: same gates on untouched confirmation partition
failure_criterion: mean_net <= 0 OR harness REJECT on discovery (or confirmation FAIL after discovery PASS)
inconclusive_criterion: mean_net > 0 but harness UNDERPOWERED/INCONCLUSIVE, or confirmation inconclusive

partitions.burn_in_feature_history: 2020-01-01 → before discovery (lookback uses prior bars only)
partitions.partition_rationale: Chosen from certified date coverage BEFORE outcome inspection so discovery and confirmation each have approx >=30 21d rebalance slots (disc~42, conf~31), enabling a defensible independent confirmation rather than capping at DISCOVERY_PASS_NEEDS_FUTURE_CONFIRMATION by construction.

changed_and_why: NEW experiment_id EXP-NEXT-02B — must not overwrite EXP-NEXT-02
snapshot 2f683be0c73eaa33 / 870-name scoped CERTIFIABLE panel — material evidence expansion (Path B primary)
chronological partitions resized to 2021-01-01→2023-12-31 discovery and 2024-01-01→end confirm — required so confirmation is independently powered on longer history; not a return-based tune
panel construction allows date-wise available names (outer coverage) — required because expanded panel is not a complete rectangular 29-name dropna-any block

if_fail: REJECT_CLOSE_BRANCH — no low-vol combinations or ML rescue
